plugins.NAME: ARexx Runner
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Run configured ARexx macros by name; query text cannot supply arbitrary script paths.

plugins.NAME: Calculator
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Type = 2*(5+3), then press Enter. Integer, no FPU needed.

plugins.NAME: Clipboard Tools
plugins.DESCRIPTION: show, set:text, clear, upper, lower, or save:path.

plugins.NAME: Clock
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Press Enter for AmigaDOS local time.

plugins.NAME: Developer Tools
plugins.DESCRIPTION: hex:N, dec:$FF, ascii:N, mask:0,3,7, or prot:RWED.

plugins.NAME: File Finder
plugins.DESCRIPTION: find:<name> searches configured drawers for files and folders.

plugins.NAME: Memory
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Press Enter to display free Chip and Fast RAM.

plugins.NAME: Music Controls
plugins.DESCRIPTION: Control HippoPlayer, AmigaAMP or EaglePlayer 2 through their documented ARexx ports.

plugins.NAME: System Commands
plugins.DESCRIPTION: avail, version, flush, reboot confirm, or shutdown confirm.

plugins.NAME: Task Manager
plugins.DESCRIPTION: tasks lists processes; break:name:confirm sends Ctrl-C.

plugins.NAME: Workbench Windows
plugins.DESCRIPTION: windows lists titles; window:name or screen:name brings one forward.

themes.name: Amber
themes.description: Warm amber on near-black, like an old terminal

themes.name: MagicGrey
themes.description: MagicWB-style greys with a blue selection
